# Platform Requirements Checklist: Osteo Vision Software Platform Target

**Purpose**: Validate whether the platform target requirements are complete, clear, measurable, medically conservative, and ready for implementation review.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the three competition value areas mapped to explicit platform capabilities and user stories? [Completeness, Spec §Project Scope Alignment, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the boundaries between fluorescence analysis, AI review, and result export fully described without requiring device acquisition layers? [Completeness, Spec §Project Scope Alignment, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK003 Are offline images, synchronized frame sequences, and short videos each covered by input requirements or explicitly deferred? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Input/Output Contract]
- [ ] CHK004 Are acquisition metadata requirements defined with enough detail to support future timing, exposure, and alignment review? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the minimum required evidence artifacts for each case defined beyond broad names such as visuals, summaries, and report material? [Completeness, Spec §Evidence Artifacts, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Are candidate region, ROI, review state, quality flag, and analysis run entities each tied to at least one functional requirement? [Traceability, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §Functional Requirements]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "suspicious region" defined in non-diagnostic terms that fit ICG perfusion and tissue-viability evidence? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK008 Are "low-confidence", "low usability", and "unusable" inputs differentiated with objective criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "approved analysis method" defined with governance criteria for what makes a method approved? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 Are "candidate regions or risk regions" distinguished from reviewer-defined ROIs with clear ownership and lifecycle rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "complete evidence bundle" defined as a concrete artifact list with required and optional members? [Clarity, Spec §US3, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Are terms such as "quickly enough" and "interactive" quantified or scoped for demo conditions? [Ambiguity, Plan §Performance Goals]

## Medical Safety And Review Boundary

- [ ] CHK013 Are all user-facing and report-facing outputs required to include research-prototype disclaimers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK014 Are prohibited claims specified clearly enough to prevent automatic diagnosis, definitive surgical instruction, and unsupported clinical performance wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Are physician review states required for every AI-generated candidate region before final export? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for cases where the reviewer disagrees with all AI candidates or creates an ROI manually? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are ICG signal limitations documented as requirements for wording, labels, reports, and presentation copy? [Gap, Constitution §II, Plan §Medical Safety Boundary]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are primary import, review, ROI refinement, and export scenarios independently measurable from the written acceptance scenarios? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK019 Are alternate flows defined for single-frame versus short-sequence cases? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are exception flows defined for mismatched size, timing, content, overexposure, weak signal, blur, and occlusion? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are recovery requirements defined for interrupted export, partial artifact generation, and retry behavior? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a case with no candidate region while still needing a report? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are conflicting reviewer action rules specified for accept-then-modify, reject-then-restore, and threshold changes after acceptance? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §US2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 Can SC-001 be objectively evaluated with a defined required artifact list and representative case criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK025 Can SC-002 be objectively evaluated with thresholds or classification rules for weak-signal, mismatched, overexposed, and blurred cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK026 Does SC-003 specify which review state fields must be reflected in exported reports? [Completeness, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK027 Does SC-004 define the minimum structure for fused visual evidence, quantitative summary, review record, and disclaimer? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK028 Does SC-005 define a reviewable vocabulary or safety-wording rule for detecting unsupported diagnosis language? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Are local deployment assumptions, supported operating systems, and browser expectations specified for the V1 workstation workflow? [Completeness, Plan §Target Platform]
- [ ] CHK030 Are performance targets expressed as measurable limits for representative case loading, ROI interaction, and export? [Gap, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK031 Are privacy, de-identification, and minimum-retention requirements explicitly tied to case inputs, metadata, exports, and logs? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Tasks §Clarification Assumption]
- [ ] CHK032 Are accessibility and basic usability requirements defined for reviewer-facing image inspection and ROI controls? [Gap, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK033 Are auditability requirements defined for review history, provenance, analysis run parameters, and export timestamps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK034 Are failure messages and warning severity levels specified for medically sensitive low-confidence cases? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-007]

## Architecture And Replaceability

- [ ] CHK035 Are frontend, backend, analysis core, and export responsibilities separated in requirements without over-constraining implementation details? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK036 Are model and dataset replaceability requirements stated at the workflow contract level rather than tied to specific model families? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK037 Are configuration, adapter, pipeline, manifest, and report-writer boundaries reflected in the feature requirements or plan? [Traceability, Plan §Constitution Check, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK038 Are temporary Gradio demo constraints clearly separated from the long-term Vue/FastAPI platform target? [Clarity, Plan §Summary, Plan §Constraints]

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 Is the local single-user V1 assumption documented consistently across spec, plan, tasks, and quickstart? [Assumption, Tasks §Clarification Assumption, Plan §Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK040 Are out-of-scope dependencies such as device SDKs, HIS/EMR/PACS, full patient management, and automatic diagnosis consistently excluded? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope, Plan §Constraints, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK041 Are external data requirements and sample provenance expectations specified before any clinical or performance claims are allowed? [Dependency, Constitution §V, Spec §Medical Safety Boundary]
- [ ] CHK042 Are artifact retention and Git exclusion rules reflected in requirements for evidence bundles and generated outputs? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Tasks §Polish]
